An unidentified persons created a fake cryptocurrency wallet website onuranic.com, support@Onuranic.com. The Onuranic company doesn‚Äôt have registration, and the data on the website are fake. Their website is a simulated picture that is a fake cryptocurrency wallet. They offer the client to open a wallet in a personal account on their website. Then, the client is shown the wallet number in the personal account, but the wallet belongs to the scammers on the Blockchain. When a client tries to withdraw money from this wallet, the scammers ask to pay taxes in the amount of 15% of the amount. The client pays and this money is transferred to the wallets of scammers:  bc1q0zsr9zvkfzhs55rwdug8stwvnhu80x5hj3q8d5, bc1qm34lsc65zpw79lxes69zkqmk6ee3ewf0j77s3h. Extortions do not end after this. When a client withdraws a cryptocurrency, ONURANIC imitates the direction to its Btc Holding Slr exchanger, this company is a scammer, btc-holding-slr.com, exchange@btc-holding-slr.com. The Btc Holding extorts money from the client, under the pretense of paying for services for conversion of 10% of the amount. To deceive customers, forge bank documents. Btc sent us a fake payment document from Postepay Posteitaliane. Btc Holding also accepts the payment to the account: bc1qsg05enx9ppvhuzts0n6zkrsdmafn58c36rz9tt, bc1qur0lk9vdrhsdsyjy2tax42y0m0xu7nyt94upjn 
According to information from the sites hashxp.org and www.blockchain.com, the cryptocurrency is transferred to one wallet from all four wallets, on the Blockchain:  1JrqpfgFyPQo6ijKApw2sHerGvc7PpCAQm_x000D_
